module.Title: Movement Challenge: WASD
module.Teaching: Combine a parameter, if/else-if branches, and coordinate changes to interpret keyboard commands.
module.PredictionQuestion: Which coordinate changes for W and S?
module.PredictionExplanation: W and S move vertically, so they modify Y.
module.DebugPrompt: Repair the equality operator and change the correct coordinate in the correct direction.
module.RecallPrompt: Rebuild the complete WASD movement method. Use these exact identifiers: key, playerX, playerY.
module.TransferPrompt: Create a two-direction MoveEnemy method using left and right commands. Use these exact identifiers: enemyX, key.
module.PreviewMessage: The movement system now understands WASD-style commands.
